_source: posim/src/vm.rs — load_path() (read arms) and store_path() (write arms). Extracted line-by-line 2026-07-30; every entry's read_line/write_line points at the match arm that implements it.
_rw_legend: R = readable only; RW = readable and writable; R+refused = a write arm exists but returns a guiding error rather than writing.

object.name: id
object.meaning: user label; does not affect physics

object.name: m1
object.meaning: sphere-1 mass; write rebuilds mass, COM offsets and inertia

object.name: m2
object.meaning: sphere-2 mass; write rebuilds the body

object.name: m_rod
object.meaning: rod mass; recovered from stored mass fractions, so reads round in the 16th digit

object.name: inverse_mass
object.meaning: writing back-computes mass; 0 makes the body static (an immovable wall)

object.name: position
object.meaning: world position (the COM for every shape, including the dumbbell)

object.name: velocity
object.meaning: DERIVED: reads p/m, writes p := m v

object.name: orientation
object.meaning: w-first; renormalized to unit length on write

object.name: angular_velocity
object.meaning: derived: omega = R I^-1 R^T L; writes L := R I R^T omega

object.name: inertia_tensor
object.meaning: body frame; writing updates the inverse (singular -> zero inverse = cannot rotate)

object.name: magnetic_moment_tensor
object.meaning: maps B to torque: tau = (R M R^T) B

object.name: radius
object.meaning: writing recomputes inertia and KEEPS the shape family; a torus is REFUSED

object.name: ring_radius
object.meaning: radius c of the circle traced by the tube center

object.name: inner_radius
object.meaning: derived c - a (the hole); accepts >= 0 — 0 is the horn torus

object.name: outer_radius
object.meaning: derived c + a; writing one of the pair holds the other fixed

object.name: force
object.meaning: constant external force applied during STEP/RUN

object.name: restitution
object.meaning: bounciness e in [0,1] (default 1 = elastic); a pair uses min(e_i, e_j)

system.name: softening
system.meaning: Plummer softening length epsilon (default 1e-6); forces use (r^2+e^2)^(3/2)

system.name: b_field
system.meaning: uniform magnetic field; force q v x B, torque (R M R^T) B

system.name: collide
system.meaning: 1 when collision detection is on; SET refuses with `use COLLIDE ON / COLLIDE OFF to switch collision detection`

system.name: contacts
system.meaning: contacts recorded by the last STEP/RUN

system.name: collisions
system.meaning: running total of resolved impulses this session; deliberately NOT a keyword so this spelling stays free

system.name: restitution_threshold
system.meaning: approach speeds below this bounce with e = 0 (anti-jitter; default 1e-3)

system.name: box
system.meaning: inner side length of the rigid bounding box; 0 = none. Created/removed by the BOX command

contact.name: i
contact.meaning: lower index of the colliding pair (i < j)

contact.name: j
contact.meaning: higher index of the colliding pair

contact.name: t
contact.meaning: the event time — the root the solver landed on

contact.name: normal
contact.meaning: unit normal pointing from obji toward objj; objj receives +J n, obji receives -J n

contact.name: depth
contact.meaning: penetration depth at the event (~0 — the root lands on the touch)

contact.name: rel_vel_n
contact.meaning: approach speed along the normal (negative = approaching)

contact.name: impulse
contact.meaning: scalar impulse magnitude J that was applied

components.note: Component writes are safe read-modify-write operations through the full field's get/set pair.

path_roots.meaning: positional handle, numbered by position in the system; DEL renumbers
the simulation-wide settings and observables; reserved as a name
read-only record of the K-th contact of the last STEP/RUN
a user name registered with NEW ... AS; follows every renumbering
